invariants.description: Core review logic (finding detection, severity ranking, evidence generation) must not depend on specific web frameworks or CI/CD platforms. Framework adapters live in adapters/ and implement domain interfaces.

invariants.rule: every outbound call has a timeout
invariants.description: All HTTP requests, LLM API calls, and webhook deliveries must specify explicit timeouts. No call may block indefinitely. Default timeout: 30s for external APIs, 120s for LLM inference.

invariants.rule: untrusted input is sanitized before processing
invariants.description: PR payloads from webhooks, user-provided code snippets, and external API responses are untrusted. All input must be validated against a schema and sanitized before use in prompts, database queries, or file operations.
